search_text: published ZDI-24-1223 ZDI-CAN-23850 Ivanti Endpoint Manager AgentPortal Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-09-12 CVE-2024-29847 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-29847 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Ivanti'] ['Endpoint Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Ivanti Endpoint Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the AgentPortal service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager AgentPortal Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Ivanti Endpoint Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the AgentPortal service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
